items.title: Grow in 2027 Seedling
items.alt: Green seedling in a terracotta pot below Grow in lettering, with a cream 2027 plant label in the soil.
items.description: Two broad leaves rise between the gold-edged green words and the softly rounded pot rim.

items.title: Coffee and Goals 2027
items.alt: Navy-and-gold Coffee and Goals lettering above a frothy coffee cup, matching saucer and journal labeled 2027.
items.description: A gold spoon crosses the foreground beneath the cup's full handle and the closed book's ribbon bookmark.

items.title: Create More in 2027 Paint Palette
items.alt: Wooden artist palette with five colored paint wells, a full paintbrush and Create More in 2027 lettering.
items.description: The colorful year follows the wood grain below the cream brush lettering, beside the open thumb hole.

items.title: Fresh Start 2027 Sailboat
items.alt: Ivory-and-teal sailboat with 2027 printed on its main sail and a Fresh Start ribbon beneath the wooden hull.
items.description: Gold mast fittings and fine rigging frame the sails above a small blue wave at the base.

items.title: Class of 2027 with Cap and Diploma
items.alt: Navy-and-gold Class of 2027 lettering beneath a mortarboard and rolled diploma, framed by teal laurel sprigs.
items.description: The bold varsity numerals sit within a broad open wreath below the cream diploma and full gold tassel.

items.title: Senior 2027 Burgundy Ribbon
items.alt: Cream varsity Senior 2027 lettering across a long folded burgundy ribbon with gold edging.
items.description: Three small gold stars and one hanging tassel finish the curled right end of the full ribbon.
